extDescription.message: Add the YouTube video, playlist or channel you are viewing to your Localify server.

actionTitle.description: Tooltip of the toolbar icon, which opens the settings.

btnLoading.description: Button label while the extension checks the page with the server.

btnAdd.description: Button on a video page: queue the video for import.

btnAdding.description: Button label while the import request is sent.

btnImported.description: Disabled button: the video is already in the library.

btnImportedReview.description: Disabled button: imported, but the metadata must be checked by an admin.

btnQueued.description: Disabled button: the video waits in the import queue.

btnImporting.description: Disabled button: the server is downloading or processing the video.

btnAlreadyKnown.description: Disabled button: the server already knew this video.

btnRetryImport.description: Button after a failed import: queue it again.

btnRetry.description: Button: retry the last action after an error.

btnConfigure.description: Button shown when no server is set up: opens the settings.

btnSubscribe.description: Button on a playlist or channel page.

btnSubscribing.description: Button label while the subscription is created.

btnSubscribed.description: Disabled button: the playlist or channel is already followed.

msgQueued.message: Added to the Localify import queue.
msgQueued.description: Message after a video was queued.

msgFailed.description: Message: the import failed, no reason given.

msgFailedReason.description: Message: the import failed; REASON is the server's error (may be in another language).

msgSubscribing.message: The server is reading the list, this may take a moment.
msgSubscribing.description: Message while subscribing; reading a long playlist takes time.

msgSubscribedExisting.message: The existing videos are being added to the queue.
msgSubscribedExisting.description: Message after subscribing with the existing videos.

msgSubscribedFuture.message: New videos will be imported at each sync.
msgSubscribedFuture.description: Message after subscribing without the existing videos.

optAlbum.message: This is an album (playlist title = album)

optExisting.message: Also import the videos already published

titleTarget.description: Tooltip of the button: which Localify instance receives the action; NAME is the instance name.

errNoResponse.description: Error: the background script did not answer.

errReloaded.description: Error: the extension was updated or reloaded while the page was open.

errNotConfigured.message: Extension not set up: add a server address and a key.
errNotConfigured.description: Error: no Localify instance with an address and a key.

errUnreachable.description: Error: network failure; NAME is the instance name.

errKeyRejected.message: $NAME$: key rejected, it may have been revoked.
errKeyRejected.description: Error 401; NAME is the instance name.

errForbidden.description: Error 403; NAME is the instance name.

errThrottled.message: YouTube is limiting requests, try again later.
errThrottled.description: Error 429: YouTube refused the server's requests.

errServer.description: Other HTTP error; NAME is the instance, STATUS the HTTP code.

errServerDetail.description: HTTP error with a message from the server (often in French); NAME is the instance.

errCookiePermission.message: The “cookies” permission has not been granted.
errCookiePermission.description: Error: the optional 'cookies' permission is not granted.

errNoYoutubeCookies.message: No youtube.com cookies: sign in to YouTube in this browser.
errNoYoutubeCookies.description: Error: the browser has no youtube.com cookie.

optionsIntro.message: Add the YouTube or YouTube Music video, playlist or channel you are viewing to your Localify servers.

instancesHeading.description: Heading of the list of servers.

instancesHelp.message: Create a key in Localify: Administration → YouTube → Réglages → Extension de navigateur. It only allows adding YouTube imports and subscriptions, and sending cookies.
instancesHelp.description: Where to create a key. The path names the Localify admin UI, which is in French: keep the French labels.

instanceNew.description: Name given to a new instance before the user renames it.

fieldName.description: Label of the instance name field.

fieldUrl.description: Label of the server address field.

fieldKey.description: Label of the API key field.

fieldDefault.description: Radio button: this instance receives the clicks on the YouTube buttons.

fieldSendCookies.description: Checkbox: periodically send the YouTube cookies to this instance.

btnSaveTest.description: Button: save the instance and check the key.

btnSendCookiesNow.description: Button: send the cookies to this instance now.

btnRemove.description: Button: remove the instance from the extension.

confirmRemove.message: Remove “$NAME$” from the extension? The key stays valid on the server until it is revoked there.
confirmRemove.description: Confirmation; NAME is the instance name.

statusInvalidUrl.message: Invalid address: it must start with https:// (or http:// for a local server).
statusInvalidUrl.description: Error: the address is not an http(s) URL.

statusMissingKey.description: Error: the key field is empty.

statusPermissionDenied.message: Permission denied: the extension cannot reach this server.
statusPermissionDenied.description: Error: the user refused access to the server address.

statusConnected.message: Connected: the server accepts the key.

cookiesLastSent.description: Cookie state; DATE is a localized date and time.

cookiesLastError.description: Cookie state; ERROR is the error message.

cookiesIntro.message: When YouTube asks a server to “confirm you're not a bot”, yt-dlp needs the cookies of a signed-in YouTube session. The extension can send them for you to the instances you tick:

cookiesPoint1.message: Only this browser's youtube.com and google.com cookies are read, in Netscape format (cookies.txt), and sent to the ticked Localify instances and nowhere else.

cookiesPoint2.message: These cookies open your Google account: each server receiving them can act on YouTube on your behalf. Prefer a browser profile signed in with a secondary account.

cookiesPoint3.message: Off by default. The browser asks for the “cookies” permission the first time; it is removed when no instance receives cookies any more.

cookiesInterval.description: Label of the sending interval, in hours.
